clauses.title: CL-D105 records where clause pins live
clauses.section: ## CL-D105 — Each record's clause pins live beside it
requires: A record's pins live in `contract/<id>.clauses.json`, which holds exactly `{"clauses": [...]}` with at least one clause
The ids in a clause file equal its record's **Clauses:** line as a set; the line's order is free.
concatenated, so a clause left in two places fails as a duplicate
Putting pins back into one shared file, inside a record, or anywhere but beside their record requires a new owner decision.

clauses.title: CONTRACT.md says where clause pins live
requires: Each record's clause pins live beside it in `contract/<id>.clauses.json` (CL-D105; clauses not yet moved stay in `test/contract-clauses.json`)

clauses.title: CL-D103 names the move
requires: CL-D105 later put each record's clause pins beside it, in `contract/<id>.clauses.json`, as they move from `test/contract-clauses.json`.

clauses.title: The layout, the assembly and the evidence are pinned
requires: Issue #240 contract/ holds only indexed records and their clause files, each a regular file

Issue #240 readManifest concatenates the residual and every clause file in index order
Issue #240 a clause in two sources, a duplicate key, or a clause file of another shape fails
Issue #240 a change to a record and its clause file puts those two, CONTRACT.md and README.md in the evidence
